description: Action Plan First report type blueprint registry for HTML report generation. Action Plan appears immediately after Executive Summary; supporting sections act as evidence layer.

source_documents.role: source of truth for HTML report structure
source of truth for logical input views and data requirements

change_summary_from_v1: Inserted Action Plan / Strategic Recommendations as mandatory section immediately after Executive Summary for every report type.
Moved detailed analytical sections into Primary/Secondary Evidence Layers.
Preserved existing raw/source data requirements; new table IDs are logical input views or aliases.
Added per-report action taxonomy and action plan field contract.
Added data input mapping to new Action-Plan-First sections and minimum validation rules.
global_hard_rules: Blueprint first: do not invent sections, charts, or data inputs outside registry.
Action Plan First: action/recommendation section must follow Executive Summary.
No input schema change: raw/source data schema remains unchanged.
Evidence-backed action: each action must cite or reference available quantitative/qualitative signals.
Graceful N/A: missing data must be marked N/A, not hallucinated.
global_qa_rules: Section order must match section_order exactly.
Action Plan must appear at order 2 for every report type.
Qualitative examples must be sourced from qualitative_data tables.
Charts and tables must map to declared input views.
Final QA must reject unsupported actions, metrics, sections, or claims.

universal_report_architecture.Fungsi: Memberi konteks cepat: judul, objek analisis, industri/kategori, periode, scope sumber data.
universal_report_architecture.Catatan Implementasi: Tetap singkat; tidak perlu narasi panjang.

universal_report_architecture.Fungsi: Merangkum kondisi utama, KPI penting, key findings, dan overall posture.
universal_report_architecture.Catatan Implementasi: Maksimal 1 halaman/section ringkas; harus menjawab what happened dan why it matters.
Section wajib setelah Executive Summary. Gunakan action taxonomy sesuai report type.

universal_report_architecture.Fungsi: Membuktikan prioritas tindakan dengan analisis utama.
universal_report_architecture.Catatan Implementasi: Misal SOV/SOE untuk Competitive, trend/topic untuk Industry, topic/sentiment untuk Daily.

universal_report_architecture.Fungsi: Memperkuat dengan channel, content, author, spokesperson, atau media contributors.
universal_report_architecture.Catatan Implementasi: Section ini boleh berbeda per report.

universal_report_architecture.Fungsi: Menampilkan top content, quotes, representative statement, article evidence.

universal_report_architecture.Fungsi: Menutup dengan data period, source, note, disclaimer.

standard_action_plan_framework.Aturan Pengisian: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW. HIGH untuk isu/aksi berdampak besar atau urgent.
Gunakan taxonomy sesuai report: Scale/Fix/Test, Defend/Close Gap, Monitor/Respond, dst.
Topic, issue, channel, content format, competitor gap, spokesperson, media, sentiment driver.
Harus operasional, bukan insight abstrak. Contoh: “Perluas format short video untuk topik X di TikTok”.
Harus berbasis data: engagement, volume, sentiment, top issue, top content, atau media exposure.
Cantumkan metrik atau evidence ringkas dari section pendukung.
Misal peningkatan engagement efficiency, mitigasi risiko negatif, perluasan reach, perbaikan perception.
Opsional jika report dipakai untuk workflow internal.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Unit post/artikel/komentar yang dianalisis. Dipakai untuk count volume, total news, total mentions, atau unique content.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Pastikan deduplication rule konsisten per report.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Total interaksi. Bisa mencakup likes, comments, shares, replies, views, atau metrik lain sesuai definisi platform.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Jika komponen engagement berbeda per platform, simpan definisi di metadata report.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Platform atau tipe media. Contoh: Instagram, TikTok, X, Online Media, Printed Media, TV, Radio, Blogs.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Brand, campaign, competitor, atau objek analisis.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Untuk competitive report, Campaign digunakan sebagai brand identifier.
Jika berisi list, parse dulu sebelum agregasi.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Aspek produk/jasa/layanan yang dikaitkan dengan sentiment.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Dipakai untuk driver positif/negatif dan rekomendasi.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Entitas seperti brand, produk, tokoh, lokasi, organisasi.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Dipakai untuk evidence dan context enrichment.

field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Sumber atau figur yang menghasilkan exposure.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Digunakan untuk ranking influence, profile cards, dan evidence.

field_conventions.Field Umum: Ad Value / PR Value / Potential Reach
field_conventions.Definisi Pakai: Proxy nilai exposure, reach, atau media value.
field_conventions.Catatan Implementasi: Opsional untuk beberapa report; jika tidak tersedia, gunakan N/A.

derived_metric_conventions.Derived Metric: Total Mentions / Total News / Total Content
derived_metric_conventions.Catatan: Gunakan unique(Content) jika tersedia ID konten dan risiko duplikasi tinggi.

sort descending by Engagement, Ad Value, atau Count Content

field_normalization_notes.Content: Use as countable content/post/article unit depending report type and channel.
field_normalization_notes.Count of Content: Aggregated volume count derived from Content rows.
field_normalization_notes.Engagement: Total engagement metric from source platform; exact formula owned by data layer.
field_normalization_notes.Ad Value: Media value metric; should be summed only where available.
field_normalization_notes.PR Value: PR value metric; should be summed only where available.
field_normalization_notes.Potential Reach: Potential reach metric; should be summed or deduplicated based on data warehouse definition.
field_normalization_notes.Topic Extraction: Parsed topic tokens/labels before aggregation when source contains multi-value topics.
field_normalization_notes.Aspect Based Sentiment: Aspect-level sentiment label or aspect phrase; split by Sentiment where available.
field_normalization_notes.Spokesperson: Must come from explicit spokesperson extraction/statement field, not inferred from author unless mapped by data layer.

known_source_issues_normalized: Action Plan First changes report section ordering only; it does not require raw data schema changes.
Some new table IDs are canonical logical views and must be mapped to existing v1 input IDs/function bindings through alias registry.
BCE adds explicit logical views for brand_content_summary, top_content_patterns, and recommendation_inputs; these can be derived from existing top content qualitative outputs.
DSM uses dsm prefix as canonical Action-Plan-First naming; old smr prefix remains supported through aliases.
MMR uses mm prefix as canonical Action-Plan-First naming; old mmr prefix remains supported through aliases.
